name: model_export_derivative

description.what: Starts a translation and returns a task handle — it never blocks waiting for the result.
description.when: Use when a downstream step needs a derivative that does not exist yet.
description.whenNot: Not for reading an existing derivative, and never inside a loop that waits on it.

blastRadius: Starts a billable translation job. A duplicate call without a stable requestKey runs and bills it twice.
